An unsettling atmosphere hung between 
Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek.

As someone aiming for the very same glory, 
I can't just leave her be—

Having helped mediate their 
reconciliation, one could only watch on as 
someone who might one day become a rival 
continued to grow.

And as a token of gratitude, Trainer 
Kiryuin handed over the "Trainer's White 
Paper"—a secret manual detailing the 
ultimate secrets of raising Umamusume.

The Kiryuin Family Trainer White Paper. 
The Umamusume training secrets written 
within contributed greatly to <chrname>'s growth!
